milestones.title: Skeleton imports
milestones.goal: Every module under src/main/** (Constants, DuplicateHeaderMode, QuoteMode, Token, IOUtils, ExtendedBufferedReader, Lexer, CSVFormat, CSVPrinter, CSVRecord, CSVParser) imports cleanly with signatures and type annotations intact; bodies may still be `pass`. build_check passes.

milestones.title: Leaf constants and enums
milestones.goal: Implement Constants (all char/string/int constants), QuoteMode (5 sentinel members), DuplicateHeaderMode (3 sentinel members), and Token plus its nested Type (5 sentinel members, content buffer, isReady/isQuoted, reset()). No inter-class runtime dependencies among these.

milestones.title: I/O leaf utilities
milestones.goal: Implement IOUtils (copy0/1, copyLarge0/1, rethrow, DEFAULT_BUFFER_SIZE) and ExtendedBufferedReader (lookAhead0/1/2, read0/1, getCurrentLineNumber, readLine) using a manual pushback buffer since these depend only on Constants.

milestones.title: CSVFormat (Builder, Predefined, presets, validation)
milestones.goal: Fully implement CSVFormat, its nested Builder (every setXxx/setXxx0/setXxx1 fluent setter), nested Predefined (13 named presets wired after CSVFormat's public static final constants), the 13 CSVFormat presets (DEFAULT, EXCEL, INFORMIX_UNLOAD, INFORMIX_UNLOAD_CSV, MONGODB_CSV, MONGODB_TSV, MYSQL, ORACLE, POSTGRESQL_CSV, POSTGRESQL_TEXT, RFC4180, TDF), validate(), equals/hashCode/toString, and the low-level print*/printWithQuotes*/printWithEscapes* writers. The parse/print/printer convenience methods may just construct CSVParser/CSVPrinter (trivial delegation) without depending on their internals being correct yet.

milestones.title: Lexer
milestones.goal: Implement Lexer fully: nextToken, parseSimpleToken, parseEncapsulatedToken, isDelimiter/isEscapeDelimiter/isQuoteChar/isCommentStart/isEndOfFile/isStartOfLine, readEscape, readEndOfLine, trimTrailingSpaces, and per-format char-array precomputation (delimiter/delimiterBuf/escapeDelimiterBuf, DISABLED sentinel), depending on Token, ExtendedBufferedReader, Constants, and CSVFormat.

milestones.title: CSVRecord
milestones.goal: Fully implement CSVRecord: values storage (never-null list, EMPTY_STRING_ARRAY substitution), recordNumber, characterPosition, comment, get0/1/2, isSet0/1, isMapped, isConsistent, toMap, toList, stream, putIn, iterator, toString/__str__. The parser back-reference (getHeaderMapRaw()) is wired but only becomes exercised once M6 lands.

milestones.title: CSVParser (Headers, CSVRecordIterator, full parse pipeline)
milestones.goal: Fully implement CSVParser and its sibling classes Headers and CSVRecordIterator: nextRecord() driving the Lexer token loop, createHeaders() (duplicate/blank handling per DuplicateHeaderMode), getRecords()/stream()/iterator(), getHeaderMap()/getHeaderNames(), getHeaderComment()/hasHeaderComment(), getTrailerComment()/hasTrailerComment(), getCurrentLineNumber(), getRecordNumber(), getFirstEndOfLine(), and all parse0..parse5 static factories (File/InputStream/Path/Reader/String/URL) funneling into the 4-arg constructor.

milestones.title: CSVPrinter
milestones.goal: Fully implement CSVPrinter: print, println, printComment, printRecord0/1/2, printRecords0/1, flush/close semantics (close0/1, AutoFlush), producing byte-for-byte matching CSV text (quoting/escaping, recordSeparator, trailing delimiter) on the given Appendable/text stream.

milestones.title: Golden: full contract parity
milestones.goal: Every Java class, field, and method (including private CSVFormat helpers __printWithQuotes0/1, __printWithEscapes0/1, __print3/5, __isDelimiter, __append0/1, __isTrimChar0/1, __isLineBreak0/1, __containsLineBreak, __contains, __validate) has a faithful, non-stubbed Python counterpart; no pass/.../TODO/NotImplementedError remains anywhere in src/main/**. The full observable contract (format validation, parsing, header handling, printing, exceptions) is reproduced end-to-end.
